Emails.Subject: Meridian Health Alliance - delivery concern
Emails.Body:
Team,

Meridian Health Alliance escalated a temperature-controlled shipment that arrived later than planned. They want a root-cause explanation. Valence Cold Chain Logistics is the carrier.

David

Emails.Subject: RE: Meridian Health Alliance - delivery concern
Emails.Body:
I'll ask Valence Cold Chain Logistics for the shipment record today. David, please hold a call with the account.

Charlotte

Emails.Subject: RE: Meridian Health Alliance - delivery concern
Emails.Body:
Valence confirmed a carrier delay, no temperature excursion. Meridian accepted the explanation and wants a continuity commitment.

David

Emails.Subject: Meridian renewal plan

Planning the Meridian Health Alliance renewal. Can you share formulary timing and adoption data?

David
